main.description: Build-derived description of one collection this gazetteer serves. One record per served collection, keyed by the described collection's NSID, regenerated on every export. Values describe the build being served, not a promise about future builds. Category and attribute vocabularies are observed, not closed: absence means no served record carries the value, not that the value is invalid.

attribution.description: URL of the source's attribution or copyright page, for display.

generatedAt.description: When the serving build was exported. Identical to the generated_at in every tile of the release.

extent.description: Bounding box of the served records, aligned to tile boundaries.

locationTypes.description: Location-union member lexicons this collection's records emit.

containmentLevels.description: Containment levels observed in the records' within relations. Absent when records carry none.

categories.description: Observed primary-category values with record counts, descending by count.

attributes.description: Attribute keys this collection's records may carry.
